info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Connect API
info.description:
Manage content, channels, and media in Experience Cloud CMS. Supports creating, updating, and delivering managed content across channels for headless content delivery and site publishing. Part of the Salesforce Connect REST API.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support
